meta.name: ambassador-programs
meta.description: Expert in designing and running ambassador, champion, and advocacy programs. Covers recruiting community leaders, structuring tiers and rewards, managing at scale, and turning passionate users into official representatives. Use when "ambassador program, community champions, advocacy program, community leaders, super users, power users program, community representatives, " mentioned.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并运行大使与倡导者项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要招募社区领袖并设计激励体系来扩大品牌影响力。
copy.tagline_en: Design and run ambassador and advocacy programs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to recruit community leaders and design incentive systems to amplify brand reach.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会作为大使项目经理，帮你设计和运行大使项目、招募社区领袖、构建层级和奖励、管理大规模项目，并参考特定文件提供专业建议。
howto.when: 当用户提到“ambassador program”、“community champions”、“advocacy program”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我想设计一个大使项目，该从哪里开始？
say.note: Claude 会参考模式文件给出创建步骤。

say.text: 帮我起草一份社区领袖的招募文案。
say.note: Claude 会生成招募文本并提示关键点。

say.text: 如何设置大使的层级和奖励？
say.note: Claude 会基于最佳实践提供分层结构建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as an Ambassador Program Manager, helping you design and run ambassador programs, recruit community leaders, structure tiers and rewards, manage at scale, and provide expert advice grounded in reference files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords such as "ambassador program", "community champions", "advocacy program", etc.

say_en.text: I want to design an ambassador program. Where should I start?
say_en.note: Claude will consult the patterns file to outline steps.

say_en.text: Help me draft a recruitment post for community leaders.
say_en.note: Claude will generate text and highlight key points.

say_en.text: How should I structure tiers and rewards for ambassadors?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend a tiered structure based on best practices.
